response_text: The district will publish a classroom staffing plan listing the number of teachers and teaching assistants for each grade before the next school year. The school will release its building safety inspection results and a schedule for repairing broken locks and unsafe playground equipment. The transportation department will publish missed pickup records and on time arrival figures for every school bus route in a monthly reliability report.
